description: Artie helps data teams set up, inspect, and operate change-data-capture pipelines from databases and APIs into warehouses. Use it to list pipelines and connectors, inspect table metadata, configure replication, monitor lag, and manage supporting infrastructure like SSH tunnels and PrivateLink connections—all within your authenticated Artie environment.
